players.name: Will Anderson Jr.
players.comment: Anderson posted four tackles (two solo), including 1.0 sacks, and one forced fumble during the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

players.name: Danielle Hunter
players.comment: Hunter (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Colts.

players.name: Jake Hansen
players.comment: Hansen posted 12 tackles (four solo) during Houston's 27-24 loss to Cleveland on Sunday.

players.name: Henry To'oTo'o
players.comment: To'oTo'o finished Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns with seven tackles (two solo).

players.name: Reed Blankenship
players.comment: Blankenship is expected to move back into the defensive starting lineup Thursday night against the Colts, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Kamari Lassiter
players.comment: Lassiter (wrist) does not have any injury designation ahead of Thursday night's game against the Colts.

players.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
players.comment: Fairbairn converted his sole field-goal attempt and made all three PATs in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

players.name: Xavier Hutchinson
players.comment: Hutchinson is expected to continue to benefit from elevated playing time Thursday against the Colts while Marvin Harrison (hamstring) is sidelined for a second straight game, Jared Koch of SI.com reports.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.comment: Dell brought in three of four targets for 21 yards and rushed once for no gain in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

players.name: Keylan Rutledge
players.comment: Rutledge (neck) was a full participant in Monday's walkthrough practice.

players.name: Dalton Schultz
players.comment: Schultz caught one pass for an 11-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.comment: Montgomery (groin) doesn't have an injury designation and is expected to play in Thursday's game against the Colts, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Arden Key
players.comment: Key (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

players.name: CJ Allen
players.comment: Allen posted nine tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, and one pass defense during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

players.name: Sauce Gardner
players.comment: According to Jane Slater of NFL Network, Gardner (calf) is not in line to play Thursday night against the Texans.

players.name: Charvarius Ward
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Justin Walley
players.comment: Walley registered five tackles, a sack, a forced fumble and two pass breakups in Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins.

players.name: Spencer Shrader
players.comment: Shrader made his sole field-goal attempt and converted all three PATs in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

players.name: Laquon Treadwell
players.comment: Treadwell caught three passes on as many targets for 24 yards and a touchdown during Indianapolis' 24-22 win over Miami on Sunday.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.comment: Burks failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded one tackle on special teams.

players.name: Anthony Gould
players.comment: Gould (toe) is active for Thursday night's game against the Texans.

players.name: Bernhard Raimann
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Jalen Travis
players.comment: inactive

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.comment: Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while adding five carries for nine yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.comment: Warren rushed once for three yards and brought in two of three targets for one yard in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.comment: Taylor rushed 16 times for 83 yards and brought in two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Indianapolis.
